title: Tibik pickups catalog
description: Authoring schema for assets/pickups/catalog.json. Drives editor autocomplete + validation; the mod ignores it. See generate_pickups_data.cmake (build-time) and pickups_catalog.cpp (runtime OTA) for the consumers.

$schema.description: Editor schema pointer; not read by the mod.

name.description: Level name. The loader derives levelId as fnv1a32(name); this string is the sole level identity.

id.description: Informational only. Neither the build-time generator nor the runtime reads this - levelId is fnv1a32(name). Safe to omit.

pickups.description: Pickup entity ids for this level (uint32).
